prompt:
Flux run using all available nodes and cores and the HNS simulation on a 32x32x16 grid using the in.reaxff.hns file and suppress the citation output ensuring each task is pinned for performance.
The lmp binary is in /usr/local/bin. The data is in /opt/lammps-reax. Do NOT specify a queue. Set a max duration of 3m.You MUST have parameters x,y,z in the command, and you MUST use a tool to validate your lammps parameters before submit.

receipt.reasoning: The cluster resources (5 nodes, 320 cores) were identified and the LAMMPS command with the requested 32x32x16 dimensions was validated. The job was submitted to Flux with mandatory performance flags (cpu-affinity, exclusive) and citation suppression. Monitoring of job logs confirmed the successful replication of the HNS system to 4,980,736 atoms and the completion of the 100-step simulation within the 3-minute limit.
